title: Data for study "A Multicenter Study to Standardize a Mouse Pneumonia Model with Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Klebsiella pneumoniae for Antibiotic Development"
question: How stable are assay response relationships across laboratories and complete runs?
publisher: Hansen, Jon Ulf (Statens Serum Institut); Arrazuria, Rakel (Paul-Ehrlich-Institut, Federal Institute for Vaccines and Biomedicines); Hoover, Jennifer (GSK); Kerscher, Bernhard (Paul-Ehrlich-Institut, Federal Institute for Vaccines and Biomedicines); Huseby, Douglas (Uppsala University); Sordello, Sylvie (Infectious Diseases, Evotec); Gribbon, Philip (Fraunhofer Institute for Translational Medicine and Pharmacology (ITMP)); Gadiya, Yojana (Fraunhofer Society); von Berlin, Leonie (Fraunhofer Institute for Translational Medicine and Pharmacology (ITMP)); Witt, Gesa (Fraunhofer Institute for Translational Medicine and Pharmacology (ITMP)); Tassi, Natália (Paul-Ehrlich-Institut, Federal Institute for Vaccines and Biomedicines); Rosenborg, Frederikke (Statens Serum Institut); Cao, Sha (Uppsala University); Bekeredjian-Ding, Isabelle (Philipps University of Marburg); Lindahl, Otto (Uppsala University); Hughes, Diarmaid (Uppsala University); Friberg, Lena (Uppsala University); Vingsbo Lundberg, Carina (Statens Serum Institut)
variables_and_units: assay responses, standards, controls and laboratory metadata
independent_units: laboratory and entire assay run, retaining failed runs
validation_design: laboratory and entire assay run, retaining failed runs Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Forty-nine source workbooks: GSK, PEI and SSI experiments plus overview, including unsuccessful runs.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Leave out laboratories or whole runs, with calibration standards treated explicitly. Preclinical assay validity does not establish clinical efficacy.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
